en.label: [section] Aim of the course and learning outcomes:
en.content: The aim is to provide an overview of the basic areas of document processing. The student will be able to process a common professional document of a smaller scale in terms of typesetting using a template for professional documents.

en.label: [section] Course content:
en.content: 1.Introduction to Document Processing (allowance 2/2) a.First steps with technologiesb.Structural markuping and its advantages2.Typesetting Rules (allowance 2/2)3.Basic Typesetting Elements (allowance 2/2)4.Professional Documents (allowance 2/2) a.Template for professional documentsb.Introduction to bibliographic references5.Adjustment of Typesetting Parameters (allowance 2/2)6.Preparation of Own Professional Document; Project (allowance 4/4)
